# Pixcellor™

> Pixcellor is a UK digital agency that builds bespoke, fast-loading websites and full-stack web apps for small businesses, starting from £169 one-off or £89/month, with lifetime warranty, SEO/AEO, unlimited edits and a 2-week MVP sprint option.

Pixcellor offers two one-off builds — Full Works (£169 one-off) and Elite Build (£479 one-off) — and three monthly retainers: Growth (£89/mo, £890/yr), Scale (£369/mo, £3,690/yr) and Enterprise (£2,469/mo, £24,690/yr). Services include web design, web development, app development, full-stack development, SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimisation), Web3, blockchain and AI integration.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Pixcellor overview, packages, portfolio and contact.
- [Full Works package](/packages/full-works): £169 one-off site, lifetime warranty, 3 pages, base animations.
- [Elite Build package](/packages/elite): £479 one-off animated site or web app, unlimited revisions, SEO/AEO, 10-day turnaround.
- [Growth Retainer](/packages/retainer-growth): £89/mo (£890/yr) always-on web team — site, CRM, hosting, AI bots, analytics.
- [Scale Retainer](/packages/retainer-scale): £369/mo (£3,690/yr) full digital department — unlimited seats, AI agents, priority SLA, monthly strategy.
- [Enterprise Retainer](/packages/retainer-enterprise): £2,469/mo (£24,690/yr) fractional CTO/CMO, dedicated dev team, 2-week MVP sprints, 24/7 support.
